note: Synthetic rows for the mock connector of 5.11. Every value is invented: no document number, name or date of birth here belongs to a real document or a real person. kind and matched_on are app.risk.watchlist's own vocabulary, so a row found by document_number carries document_number and nothing else, and an identity_seen row carries no document number. An identity_seen row carries both shapes a caller may look a name up in -- the printed MRZ form and the tidied one -- because they are not the same string. These values are matched against and never returned: a hit names the entry_id only.
